newsitem.title: UK: Zeneca eases after trading statement.
newsitem.headline: Zeneca eases after trading statement.

text.p: Shares in Zeneca Group Plc were indicated lower on Tuesday after the UK pharmaceutical concern said that its 1996 results will be in line with market forecasts.
The shares were off 8-1/2p to 1685 at 0813 GMT in in pre-market dealings.
"These shares generally have a bit of a retracement on the trading statement," said one market maker. "It's just routine. But the statement is in line and there are no worries."
Market-makers said they expected to see some light profit-taking in the shares, which have been lifted recently by renewed takeover speculation and the depreciation in sterling.

The company said new product sales exceeded expectations and that growth in pharmaceutical profits is expected to be up slightly in 1996 from a year ago, while agro-chemical profit growth is expected to slow slightly from 1995.
Zeneca will publish its full-year results on March 11.
